title: Error correction Q by default
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 10. Step 9 — Render the QR code; HCERT Specification, 4.2.2 QR 2D Barcode.

statements.label: Error correction Q by default
statements.requirement: Error-correction level SHALL default to Q and SHALL be configurable. Symbol version SHALL be the smallest that fits unless the caller pins one.
